## Weekly delivery checklist

### Scope and design

- [ ] This PR is on the correct `week/NN-topic` branch and does not develop on `main`.
- [ ] The weekly plan and task contract are linked below.
- [ ] Every changed path is owned by the task contract.
- [ ] Architecture/ADR changes are linked or explicitly not needed.
- [ ] No later-week capability was implemented early.

### Validation and evidence

- [ ] Backend lint, format, type check, and unit tests are reported.
- [ ] Frontend lint, type check, unit tests, and build are reported.
- [ ] Compose and secret-scan results are reported.
- [ ] `git diff --check` and a full diff review were completed.
- [ ] The weekly evidence report includes exact commands and observed results.

### Security and release

- [ ] No secret, `.env`, personal data, private path, or real enterprise data is included.
- [ ] Paid-model use and actual cost are disclosed (W1 must be zero).
- [ ] Known limitations and deferred next-week work are listed.
- [ ] This PR has not been merged, pushed, or tagged without authorization.
